RNClientIoShutdown is an additive bounded ownership abstraction for sdk/rocketnet_client_transport.cpp (rocketnet_client_transport_stop, rocketnet_client_transport_stopped and rocketnet_client_transport_destroy): RequestStop publishes the final filling ring while another is sending; RequestReturn and PollReturn do not depend on worker progress; WorkerQuiesce follows ring drain and key wipe; WorkerExit, Join and Free separate completion from final thread ownership. CompletionMeansQuiescent, FreedOnlyAfterJoin, NoReuseBeforeComplete, RequestNeverWaits and PollNeverWaits cover the intended sequence, with stuck-worker and six reversed witnesses. The same request/completion contract applies to the public client/server and both transports, but this model is not a refinement or composition of their data-path models and does not prove native cancellation, C++ atomic ordering, callback termination, platform cleanup or latency; exact implementation and platform qualification remain separate. Environment actions Done. Done is a terminal stutter.

Reap(c) is rocketnet_server_uring_reap_cqe by tag kind (send, recv, cancel), the recv case rocketnet_server_uring_receive_cqe splitting the buffer at its UDP_GRO stride (rocketnet_uring_recvmsg_parse, rocketnet_coalesce_split) and copying every segment into the fill bank whether reaped from receive_packets or inside send_packets, and the term case re-arming through rocketnet_server_uring_arm unless destroying; ReturnBuffer(b) is the io_uring_buf_ring_add at the end of rocketnet_server_uring_receive_cqe, after the last segment is copied (ReturnAfterLastCopy); Swap is rocketnet_server_uring_receive_packets and TransportReads is rocketnet_server_uring_process_packets; invariants TypeOK, NoReuseWhileKernelOwned, ExposedStable, BufferReturnedAfterCopy and FreedOnlyWhenDrained, liveness SubmittedEventuallyFree and DestroyEventuallyFrees under SpecFair; passing control MCRNUringDriver.cfg and reversed witnesses MCRNUringDriverBrokenResetBeforeReap.cfg (NoReuseWhileKernelOwned), MCRNUringDriverBrokenOneBank.cfg (ExposedStable), MCRNUringDriverBrokenFreeRunAtSubmit.cfg (NoReuseWhileKernelOwned: a run's slots after its head handed back at Submit) and MCRNUringDriverBrokenReturnBeforeSplit.cfg (BufferReturnedAfterCopy: a coalesced buffer returned once its first segment is copied). Where the code refines the model: one multishot per queue rather than one; Submit runs in chunks interleaved with Reap, with sends in flight capped at ROCKETNET_URING_ENTRIES; a cancel that finds no request is sent again; and destroy's wait is bounded (ROCKETNET_URING_DESTROY_WAIT_ROUNDS): a destroy that gives up never reaches Free, it exits the ring and closes the sockets but leaks the kernel-visible memory (buffer rings, queues, driver allocation) rather than freeing it, counted by rocketnet_server_uring_leaked_bytes and rocketnet_server_uring_leaked_transports, so FreedOnlyWhenDrained holds on both branches. RNBufferHandoff models the N-buffer handoff of sdk/rocketnet_buffer_handoff.h as the client transport uses it in both directions (api/BUFFER-HANDOFF-DECISION-20261021.md): N preallocated buffers, each owned by exactly one of the producer, the ready queue, the consumer and the free queue; only indices move, inside a mutex held for the exchange alone; the game thread only try-acquires it and never waits; the I/O thread acquires it and waits on a level-triggered wake. Commit writes every forget and then every mark into the kernel map in one commit, and the forget of an address drops the reply MAC the transport learned for it (rocketnet_server_socket_replay_forget).
Connect starts a session with the opened high water at zero. UserOpen raises that high water on a genuine session packet.
Release ends the session for the slot being cleared.
The maintenance pass walks marks and then commits them. Steps Walk and Commit.

The walk is rocketnet_server_replay_marks_walk: the forget pass forgets the address of every slot that was seen connected and is no longer connected or whose mapping address changed, whether or not it held a mark, and the mark pass marks every connected slot whose highest_opened is nonzero and changed and records every connected slot with a mapping as seen at its address. Steps Walk and Commit.
Connect leaves the replay window unchanged when a session takes a slot.

A taken sequence is spent unsent when the frame is refused, a seal refusal after the fragment reservation spends the fragmented start, and the outbox goes on the wire in fill order. Steps BurnOne, BurnFragmented and Flush.

A taken sequence is spent unsent when the seal fails, a seal refusal after the fragment reservation spends the fragmented start, and the staged packets go on the wire in fill order. Steps BurnOne, BurnFragmented and Flush.
